hints.text: The denominator of the exponent is a root; the numerator is a power.

learningObjective: Evaluate a fractional exponent as a root and a power.
explanation: $a^{m/n}$ means the $n$th root of $a$, raised to the $m$th power.
Rooting before powering keeps the numbers small — going the other way means computing $27^2 = 729$ and then taking its cube root.

alternativeExplanations.title: Rewrite the base as a power
steps: When the base is a perfect power, this route is the cleanest and involves no roots at all.
